home.why-totem-astrology.h2.a-tool-for-u: He Utaunga mō te Māramatanga — Ehara i te Take mō te Whanonga Kino
home.why-totem-astrology.p.at-the-heart-: Kei te ngākau o Totem Astrology te tūmanako: te tūmanako ki te mārama ake ki a koe anō, te tūmanako ki te māramatanga pai ake i waenga i ngā hoa me ngā mema whānau, me te tūmanako kei reira ētahi tāngata e rite ana ki a koe tonu.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.the-four-anim: Ka homai e ngā kaiārahi kararehe e whā he reo tūhono — he mea abstract hei tohu ina he uaua te whakaingoa i ngā mea o roto. Ina e ngana ana te Makimaki ki te whakapiki i te Pūru ki runga i te rākau, ka taea e tātou te kōrero mō te pakanga me te kore e tino whaiaro. He tohu ngā kararehe i ngā momo o roto e mahi nei tātou, ā, ka hono tātou ki te kupu aroha.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.this-is-a-too: He utaunga tēnei mō te māramatanga ki a tētahi ki a tētahi me te tuku aroha — he aroha i whānau mai i te mōhio ki ō tātou rerekētanga me te mihi ki ngā huarahi rerekē e neke ai ngā tāngata i te ao. Ehara tēnei i te take mō te whanonga kino, ā, ehara i te take hei whakaae i te whanonga kino a ētahi atu ina ka whara. I hangaia a Totem Astrology hei whakamārama, kaua hei herehere: ka ako tātou ki ō tātou rerekētanga kia taea ai te tū mō tātou anō me tētahi ki a tētahi me te manawanui nui ake, kaua te iti ake o te kawenga.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.take-what-res: Tangohia ngā mea e pā ana, waiho i ngā mea kāore — ā, kaua e whakamahi i ēnei kaiārahi hei whakatika i te nanakia, te wareware, te noho rānei ki tētahi wāhi kāore e haumaru. Ka taea e te tūmanako me ngā rohe te noho i te rūma kotahi.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.the-lan: Te reo i muri i ō kaiārahi e whā — tūhuratia ia paparanga, kātahi ka kitea katoatia i te whārangi kotahi.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.spirit-: Wairua, Hinengaro, Ngākau, me Tinana — e whā hoa kararehe nō tō tau, marama, rā, me te hāora whānau.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.water-w: Wai, Rākau, Ahi, Whenua, me Konganuku — ka hono ia wāhanga o tō pou totem i tētahi kararehe ki tētahi o ēnei Huānga e Rima, e tāpiri ana i te āhua ki ō kaiārahi Wairua, Hinengaro, Ngākau, me Tinana.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.each-to: Ka kawe ia kararehe totem i te polarity ū mai te tīmatanga — Kiore rākau i ngā wā katoa Yang, Pūru i ngā wā katoa Yin, Taika i ngā wā katoa Yang, Ngeru i ngā wā katoa Yin, ā haere tonu.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.four-co: Ka whakarite ngā uara matua e whā i ngā kararehe tekau mā rua ki ngā tapatoru e whakaahua ana i ngā mea e tino manaakitia ana e ia kaiārahi.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.within-: I roto i ia Tapatoru Uara, ka purei ngā kararehe e toru i tētahi o ngā Tūranga Tapu e toru: te Kaitoro, te Matakite, te Ariki rānei — e toru huarahi rerekē hei whakatinana i te uara matua o tērā tapatoru.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.a-simpl: He nekehanga timezone ngāwari ki te Wā Nepal (NPT) i mua i te tātai — he punga māramahiko mō te pānui i ngā pou rā me hāora.
home.h2.a-revolution-in-how-we-understan: He Hurihanga i te Āhua e Mārama ai Tātou ki ō Tātou Whanaungatanga ki Ētahi Atu me ngā Wāhanga Taupatupatu o roto i a Tātou
home.p.untangle-the-complexities-of-life: Wetewetehia ngā uauatanga o te ora i tēnei ao hou, digital mā te hono anō ki te mātauranga tawhito o ngā totem kararehe e whā motuhake i whānau mai koe
home.p.meet-your-four-totem-guides-and: Tūtaki ki ō kaiārahi totem e whā ka kitea ngā pūmanawa o roto i whānau mai koe hei tohatoha.
home.p.understand-the-totem-dynamics-bet: Mārama ki ngā dynamika totem i waenga i a koe me tētahi hoa — te kūtoni, te pākaha, me te kaupapa tūhono.
home.p.map-totem-patterns-across-your-fa: Maherehia ngā tauira totem puta noa i tō whānau hei whakaora i ngā porowhita tawhito me te whakakaha i te hononga.
home.p.align-your-work-and-ambitions-wit: Whakahāngaihia āu mahi me ō whāinga ki ō kaha totem me te wā e tautoko ana i a rātou.
home.p.find-the-people-and-opportunities: Kimihia ngā tāngata me ngā āheinga e ōrite ana ki ō kaiārahi — ngā hoa, te hapori, me ngā tīmatanga hou.
home.p.opt-in-with-your-four-totem: Tīpako kia uru me ō kararehe totem e whā ka tirotiro i ētahi atu i te pātengi tūmatanui — e ōrite ana mā ngā hononga Rainbow, Shadow, Trine, Mirror rānei.
home.p.discover-your-four-totem-animal-g: Kimihia ō kaiārahi kararehe totem e whā mō te kore utu — Wairua, Hinengaro, Ngākau, me Tinana — mai tō rā, wā, me te tāone whānau.
home.p.every-session-follows-a-clear-com: Ka whai ia wātaka i tētahi hātepe mārama, pai mai te whakapā tuatahi ki te whaiwhai.
home.p.choose-a-service-and-send-a: Tīpakohia he ratonga ka tukua he karere me tō rā, wā, me te wāhi whānau mēnā kei a koe.
home.p.we-ll-confirm-details-and-book: Ka whakau tātou i ngā taipitopito ka pukapuka he wātaka ataata i te wā e pai ana ki a koe.
home.p.a-focused-conversational-reading-: He pānui kōrerorero e hāngai ana ki āu pātai — kua hopukina māu hei tiro anō.
home.p.receive-a-written-summary-and-opt: Ka whiwhi koe i tētahi whakarāpopototanga tuhituhi me te whaiwhai kōwhiri hei whakahōhonu i tō māramatanga i te wā.
home.faq.p.animal-names-birth-times-comp: Ngā ingoa kararehe, ngā wā whānau, te compatibility, me te take e rerekē ai ngā kararehe ōrite i ngā tāngata e rua.
home.p.whether-you-re-new-to-astrology: Ahakoa he hou koe ki te astrology, e whakahōhonu ana rānei i tētahi mahi kua tīmata, ko tō hipanga tuatahi he kōrerorero.
